## Research profile

Computational and cognitive neuroscience researcher studying the temporal dynamics of EEG phase-synchronization networks. Primary interests include metastability, individual differences, brain-state representations, and interpretable analysis of high-dimensional neural dynamics.

## Research experience

**National Institute for Physiological Sciences**  
Research on EEG phase-synchronization dynamics, metastability, individual differences, and computational analysis of brain states.

## Research methods

EEG preprocessing; CSD; ICA; complex Morlet wavelets; phase synchronization; MSI; SCE; network dynamics; PCA; NMF; ICA; UMAP; clustering; HMM; permutation statistics; ICC; nonlinear regression.

## Programming and research tools

MATLAB · Python · EEGLAB · FieldTrip · Git/GitHub · LaTeX
